text:
Now a blurry phone photo of the same plan.
It grades an F: the resolution is too low, it is rotated, it was taken at an angle, and it has no scale.
The app lists each problem with its fix, and asks for a better file.
Then drag the new file into the box.

Space weather comes live from NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center: the K P index, the storm level, and the chance of radio blackouts.
Each download is checked, and marked Verified, with the time.
During a geomagnetic storm, a warning shows beside compass bearings on other pages, so you aim with G P S instead.
With no internet, it shows the last forecast and when it was downloaded.
